_comment: Root-cause notes for production smoke #32. No secrets, no prompt content.

root_cause.summary: ContentDataPlan always tried AI first, even when the deterministic projection was sufficient for booking. The first-come global budget (MAX_CALLS from env) was exhausted by BCP + Content AI calls combined, and the post-hoc _check_usage raised a vague error with no typed code.
root_cause.refused_step: post-Content cumulative check (not a pre-call denial)

key_changes: ContentDataPlan now tries project_content_data_plan (deterministic) FIRST; AI is only attempted if deterministic validation fails.
content_data_plan holds a reservation of 1 call until it resolves; deterministic success releases the reservation WITHOUT charging it.
budget.approve() is called BEFORE each provider call; denials are typed (phase3a_substage_call_budget_exhausted, phase3a_total_call_budget_exhausted, etc.).
_check_usage now verifies ledger consistency and keeps the cost check; the old vague call-count raise is replaced by typed codes.
phase3a_call_ledger is persisted in preview_contract for admin diagnostics.
